questions.prompt: 다음을 듣고, 여자가 하는 말의 목적으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
choices: 학부모 간담회 참석을 독려하려고
학부모 상담 기간 연기를 안내하려고
교직원 회의 시간 변경에 대한 협조를 요청하려고
학부모 간담회를 위한 교직원 주차 장소 변경을 알리려고
지역 주민 행사를 위한 주말 교내 주차 허용을 공지하려고
questions.script:
W: Hello, this is Karen Smith, the principal of Sunnyfield High School.
I would like to inform all staff about an important plan for next
week’s Parent­Teacher Meeting. Due to limited parking on campus,
all teachers and staff should park at the nearby community center
on Wednesday. It is only a five­minute walk from the school. This
plan will ensure that parents attending the meeting have easy
access to parking. Your cooperation will greatly assist in making
this event a smooth and successful experience. Thank you in
advance for your cooperation with the parking arrangements.

윤리적인 소비를 위해 친환경 제품을 선택해야 한다.
환경을 위해 일회용 봉투의 사용을 줄여야 한다.
쇼핑할 때 할인 혜택을 잘 활용해야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음을 듣고, 여자가 하는 말의 요지로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
choices: 이해가 선행되어야 학습 효과가 극대화된다.
학생을 가르칠 때 큰 소리로 말해 집중시켜야 한다.

배운 내용을 소리내어 설명하는 것이 기억에 도움이 된다.
questions.script:
W: Hi, everyone! Welcome back to Smart Study Tips. Has your mind
ever gone blank during a test, even though you studied very hard?
Here’s a simple but effective tip. Explaining what you’ve learned
out loud can help you remember better. Just pretend you’re a
teacher and explain what you’ve learned in your own words. You
can even talk to yourself in front of a mirror. Try it. You’ll be
surprised how well it works!

questions.prompt: 대화를 듣고, 그림에서 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.
questions.script:
M: Hey, Lucy! Look at this recycling poster. What do you notice first?
W: The title at the top really stands out. It says “RECYCLE FOR A
BETTER FUTURE.”
M: Right! And below it, there’s the big recycling symbol with three
arrows forming a triangle.
W: That makes it clear that this is about recycling. On the top arrow,
there are plastic bottles.
M: Yeah, there are! Oh, look! Below the trees, there is paper, which
students often waste.
W: Right. And beside one of the bottom arrows, there are three cans.
Cans are an important item to recycle.
M: Exactly. Look at this. There’s an Earth holding a flower. That’s a
fun way to remind us that we can make a difference.
W: I agree! This poster does a great job of promoting recycling.

questions.prompt: 대화를 듣고, 남자가 할 일로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
choices: 바닥 보호용 천 가져오기

questions.script:
W: Ryan, I’m excited to paint designs on the walls of the community
center tomorrow!
M: Me too, Emily. It’s going to brighten up the neighborhood.
W: Are we all set? Let’s go over the preparations.
M: Okay. I’ve selected designs to put on each wall. What about the
paint and brushes?
W: I ordered them yesterday and they will be delivered this evening.
M: Good. What else do we need to do?
W: Oh! I guess we also need sheets to protect the ground from paint.
M: I’ve already picked them up from the art center. Did you buy
snacks for the volunteers?
W: Yes, I did. One last thing. Do we need to remind all volunteers to
bring extra clothes? Their clothes might get dirty.
M: I think we do. I’ll send a text message to them right away.
W: Perfect. The residents will love the finished walls!

questions.prompt: 대화를 듣고, 여자가 지불할 금액을 고르시오.
questions.script:
M: Hello! Welcome to Central Park Bike Rentals. How can I help you
today?
W: Hi, we’d like to rent some bikes.
M: How many bikes would you like to rent today?
W: We’ll need one adult bike and one child bike.
M: Sure! Adult bikes are 15 dollars per hour, and children’s bikes are
10 dollars per hour. How long will you be renting them for?
W: We’ll need them for two hours.
M: Got it. So, that’s one adult bike for two hours and one child bike
for two hours.
W: That’s right. We want to rent helmets too.
M: Bike rentals include helmets for safety. You should wear them while
riding the bikes in the park.
W: Okay, can I use this “GO Green” coupon today?
M: Sure, you can get a 10% discount on the total price.
W: Great! Here’s my credit card.

questions.prompt: 대화를 듣고, 남자가 학교 영화제에 갈 수 없는 이유를 고르시오.
choices: 가족 여행을 가야 해서
결혼식에 참석해야 해서
축제 행사를 진행해야 해서
학교 과제를 제출해야 해서
아르바이트 면접을 봐야 해서
questions.script:
W: Hey, Alex. Are you coming to the School Film Festival this
Saturday?
M: I wish I could, but I have to miss it this time.
W: Oh, no, why? I thought you were really looking forward to it.
M: I was! But something came up, so I can’t make it.
W: That’s too bad. You don’t have your part­time job this weekend,
right?
M: No, I’ve got the weekend off.
W: Hmm, then maybe you’re busy with some schoolwork?
M: No, I already finished my big assignments this week.
W: So, why can’t you come?
M: I’m going to my cousin’s wedding and the place is really far. It’ll
take almost the whole day to get there and back.
W: Oh, sorry to hear that. But family events like that are important.
M: Yeah, they are. I’ll definitely check out the next school film
festival.

questions.prompt: 대화를 듣고, Topas Beachcombing에 관해 언급되지 않은 것을 고르시오.
choices: 날짜
등록 방법
준비물
참가 인원
참가비
questions.script:
M: Hey, Emma, what are you reading?
W: Hi. I’m reading a post about the Topas Beachcombing activity.
M: What is that? I’ve never heard of it.
W: It’s an activity where you go along the beach and collect garbage
and make something useful or creative with it.
M: Great! When is it?
W: This Saturday, the 25th of September, at 10 a.m. on Sunset Beach.
M: Oh, it’s near my house. How can I join the activity?
W: You can sign up on their website.
M: Do I need to bring anything?
W: Yes, we’ll need gloves and a bag for the garbage.
M: No problem. Is there a participation fee?
W: No, it’s free.
M: Perfect! It sounds meaningful and fun.

questions.prompt: Time Travel VR Experience에 관한 다음 내용을 듣고, 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.
choices: VR을 통해 한국 석기 시대를 경험한다.
9월 한 달간 진행된다.
어린이를 위한 VR 체험 구역이 있다.
전문가 가이드를 현장에서 신청할 수 있다.
입장료는 무료이다.
questions.script:
M: Hello, everyone! I’m excited to tell you about the Time Travel VR
Experience happening at the Natural History Museum. This event
will let you experience the Stone Age of Korea in an amazing way
using virtual reality. It will run for the whole month of September
2025 in the Asian Gallery on the second floor. With a VR headset,
you’ll travel back in time to see how people lived in the Stone Age
of Korea and learn about their daily life. For children, there will
also be a fun and interactive VR section. Expert guides will be
available only for those who made a reservation in advance online.
There is no entrance fee and you can enjoy all the activities free of
charge.

questions.prompt: 다음 표를 보면서 대화를 듣고, 남자가 주문할 스마트 배낭을 고르시오.

That narrows it down to just two models.

observations about the animals you spot, such as their behavior or
